title: RubricCraft: Where Solutions Diverge, Criteria Emerge
abstract: arXiv:2610.31707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating language agents on open-ended, artifact-producing tasks is difficult: model-based graders can be inconsistent, while exhaustive programmatic checks are often impractical. Textual rubrics make evaluation criteria explicit, but writing them requires domain expertise. Rubrics generated from task descriptions alone can miss requirements and failure modes that become apparent in attempted solutions. We introduce RubricCraft, which treats rubric construction as the generation of natural-language specifications guided by candidate solutions. Given a task description and independently sampled solver trajectories, RubricCraft compares how each attempt satisfies or violates the task requirements and uses these differences to construct rubric criteria. translated_title: RubricCraft：解法分歧之处，评判标准自现
translated_abstract: 在开放式、产出工件的任务上评估语言智能体十分困难：基于模型的评分器可能表现不一致，而穷尽式的程序化检查往往不切实际。文本化的评分规则能使评估标准显式化，但撰写它们需要领域专业知识。仅从任务描述生成的评分规则可能会遗漏那些在尝试解题的过程中才显现出来的需求和失败模式。我们提出了 RubricCraft，它将评分规则的构建视为一种由候选解引导的自然语言规范生成过程。给定任务描述和独立采样的求解器轨迹，RubricCraft 比较各次尝试如何满足或违反任务要求，并利用这些差异来构建评分标准。它将所得标准应用于收集到的解法，并修正那些忽略错误或惩罚有效替代方案的检查项。由此产生的评分规则能够捕捉部分正确性，而无需（原文在此处截断）
tldr: RubricCraft 通过对比多个候选解法之间的满足与违反需求的差异来构建文本评分规则，从而为开放式任务提供显式且可靠的自动化评估标准。
en_tdlr: RubricCraft builds textual rubrics by comparing divergences across independently sampled candidate solutions, enabling explicit and reliable automated evaluation of open-ended tasks.
